templates.name: Cast-in-place concrete
templates.description: Footings, slabs, walls and equipment pads: submittals, formwork and embeds, rebar hold points, pre-pour release, field tests, cylinders, curing and 28-day results. ACI 301 / 318 and ASTM test methods; US customary units.

elements.name: mix-design
elements.title: Concrete mix design accepted
elements.acceptanceCriteria: An accepted mix design is on file for every class of concrete in this placement, stating specified compressive strength (f′c), maximum water-cementitious materials ratio, nominal maximum aggregate size, target slump and air content, and admixtures; supported by field strength records or trial batches. Specified values: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.recordRequired: Accepted mix submittal with reviewer's stamp and date

elements.name: rebar-submittals
elements.title: Rebar shop drawings and mill certificates accepted
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Shop drawings accepted for this placement (latest revision on site); mill certificates on file for every bar size and grade delivered, with heat numbers matching the bundle tags.
elements.recordRequired: Accepted shop drawings (revision noted) and mill certificates

elements.name: subgrade
elements.title: Subgrade / compacted base accepted
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Subgrade or base is firm, unyielding and free of standing water, frost and loose material; field density at or above the specified percentage of laboratory maximum dry density. Specified percentage: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.reference: Geotechnical report; ASTM D1557 or D698; ASTM D6938
elements.recordRequired: Field density test report covering this footprint

elements.name: form-dimensions
elements.title: Forms: dimensions, line and level
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Formed dimensions, line, level and plumb match the drawings within the tolerances in the contract documents (ACI 117 where adopted). Tolerances: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.recordRequired: Survey or tape check of key dimensions and top-of-concrete elevations

elements.name: anchor-bolts
elements.title: Anchor-bolt template surveyed before pour
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Anchor-bolt templates are rigidly fixed and surveyed before the pour: bolt diameter, projection, pattern and position against the setting plan. Position and projection tolerances: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: embeds
elements.title: Embeds, sleeves and penetrations
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Every embed plate, sleeve, blockout and penetration shown on the drawings (structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing) is present, the right size, located as dimensioned and secured against movement during placement.

elements.name: grounding
elements.title: Cast-in grounding
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Grounding conductors and connections that will be cast in are installed, connected to the reinforcement or electrode as detailed, and their stub-ups are at the locations and lengths shown. Conductor size and connection type: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.recordRequired: Photos of connections before they are covered

elements.name: bar-size-grade
elements.title: Bar size and grade
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Every bar's rolled-in size and grade marks match the accepted shop drawings and mill certificates; no substitutions without written approval.
elements.reference: ACI 301 Section 3; ASTM A615 / A706; IBC 1705.3 where special inspection applies
elements.recordRequired: Photo of bar marks with a tag or tape for scale

elements.name: bar-spacing
elements.title: Bar spacing
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Bar spacing matches the shop drawings within the specified tolerance, and clear spacing between parallel bars is not less than the largest of 1 in, one bar diameter, and 4/3 of the nominal maximum aggregate size. Spacing tolerance: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.recordRequired: Photo with a tape across the mat

elements.name: lap-lengths
elements.title: Lap lengths
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Every lap splice is at least the length scheduled on the accepted shop drawings for that bar size, at the locations shown; laps are staggered where detailed.
elements.recordRequired: Photo of a representative lap with a tape in view

elements.name: ties
elements.title: Ties
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Bars are tied so the cage or mat does not move during placement and vibration; tie-wire ends are turned away from the formed face so they do not intrude into the cover.
elements.reference: ACI 301 Section 3; CRSI Manual of Standard Practice

elements.name: supports
elements.title: Chairs and supports
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Chairs, bolsters and side-form spacers hold the reinforcement at the detailed height and cover under foot traffic; spacing close enough that the mat does not sag between supports; support type suits the exposure (plastic-protected, epoxy-coated, stainless or precast concrete where the surface is exposed).
elements.reference: ACI 301 Section 3; CRSI Manual of Standard Practice
elements.recordRequired: Photo of supports along a bar run

elements.name: clear-cover
elements.title: Clear cover (smallest measured)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Smallest clear cover measured is not less than the specified cover less the allowed tolerance (−3/8 in for members 12 in deep or less, −1/2 in for deeper members, and never more than one-third of the specified cover). Specified cover: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.recordRequired: Cover readings at the locations checked, with photos of the tape

elements.name: cleanliness
elements.title: Reinforcement cleanliness
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Reinforcement is free of mud, oil, form-release agent, ice and other coatings that reduce bond; light rust or mill scale is acceptable, loose or flaking rust is not; epoxy coating damage is repaired.
elements.recordRequired: Photo of the mat as it will be covered

elements.name: weather-plan
elements.title: Hot- or cold-weather plan (if applicable)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Where hot weather is forecast during placement, or the air temperature is expected to fall below 40 °F during the protection period, the accepted hot- or cold-weather concreting plan is on site and its materials (shade, windbreaks, blankets, heaters, evaporation control) are ready. Mark N/A when neither applies.
elements.recordRequired: Accepted hot- / cold-weather plan; forecast for the pour day

elements.name: pre-pour-release
elements.title: Pre-pour release
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Every earlier line in this ITP is passed or marked N/A; forms are clean and coated; the pour sequence, joints, pump and finishing crew are ready; testing agency is booked. Placement may start only after both signatures.

elements.name: batch-tickets
elements.title: Batch tickets reviewed (including water added)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Every truck's ticket shows mix ID, volume, batch time and any water added on site; water added does not take the mix past its maximum w/cm; concrete is discharged within 90 minutes or 300 drum revolutions of batching unless the project allows otherwise.

elements.name: slump
elements.title: Slump
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Within the slump stated on the accepted mix design and its tolerance. Target and tolerance: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.recordRequired: Field test report (time, truck and ticket number)

elements.name: air-content
elements.title: Air content
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Within the air content stated on the accepted mix design and its tolerance; required content depends on exposure class. Target and tolerance: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.reference: ASTM C231 (pressure method) or C173; ACI 318 §19.3.3

elements.name: concrete-temperature
elements.title: Concrete temperature
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Concrete temperature at discharge is not above 95 °F unless the project allows a higher limit, and not below the cold-weather minimum for the section size. Cold-weather minimum: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.recordRequired: Field test report with air temperature

elements.name: unit-weight
elements.title: Unit weight (density)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Within the density range stated on the accepted mix design. Range: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: cylinders
elements.title: Cylinders cast — set IDs and initial curing
elements.acceptanceCriteria: One strength test (two 6 × 12 in or three 4 × 8 in cylinders per test age) at least once per day, per 150 yd³ and per 5,000 ft² of slab or wall; molded within 15 minutes of sampling; initial curing at 60–80 °F protected from vibration and moisture loss.
elements.recordRequired: Cylinder set IDs and the curing location

elements.name: consolidation
elements.title: Placement and consolidation
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Concrete placed in lifts without segregation or cold joints; internal vibration inserted at spacing that overlaps the vibrator's radius of action; no honeycombing or voids visible when forms are stripped.
elements.recordRequired: Pour start and finish times; truck count

elements.name: curing
elements.title: Curing method and duration
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Curing starts as soon as finishing allows and keeps the concrete above 50 °F and moist for at least the first 7 days (3 days for high-early-strength concrete) unless the project requires longer.
elements.recordRequired: Method (e.g. curing compound, wet burlap, sheet) and the dates

elements.name: stripping
elements.title: Form stripping
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Forms and shoring removed no earlier than the time or strength stated for the element; stripped surfaces checked for honeycombing, cracks and tie holes, and defects reported. Stripping time / strength: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: anchor-bolt-survey-after
elements.title: Post-pour anchor-bolt survey
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Anchor bolts surveyed after the pour are within the setting-plan tolerances for position, projection and plumb; out-of-tolerance bolts are reported for engineering disposition. Tolerances: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: strength-results
elements.title: 7- and 28-day strength results
elements.acceptanceCriteria: 28-day acceptance: every average of three consecutive strength tests is at least f′c, and no single test falls below f′c by more than 500 psi (f′c ≤ 5,000 psi) or by more than 0.10 f′c (f′c > 5,000 psi). 7-day results are recorded for trend.

templates.name: Earthwork and compaction
templates.description: Subgrade proof-roll, fill approval, lift thickness, moisture and field density, grade check and release before building on fill.

elements.name: compaction-criteria
elements.title: Compaction criteria and test method accepted
elements.acceptanceCriteria: The required percentage of maximum dry density, moisture range, lift thickness and test frequency are stated for each fill zone, with the Proctor method named. Values: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: fill-material
elements.title: Fill material approved
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Each borrow source or stockpile has a laboratory moisture-density curve and classification; material meets the specified gradation and plasticity limits and is free of organics, debris and frozen lumps.
elements.reference: ASTM D698 or D1557; ASTM D2487
elements.recordRequired: Laboratory Proctor and classification reports per source

elements.name: proof-roll
elements.title: Subgrade proof-roll
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Exposed subgrade is proof-rolled with the specified loaded equipment; soft, pumping or yielding areas are marked and corrected before fill is placed. Equipment and rutting limit: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.recordRequired: Marked-up plan of soft areas and their correction

elements.name: lift-thickness
elements.title: Loose lift thickness
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Each loose lift is no thicker than the specified maximum for the compaction equipment in use. Maximum: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: moisture
elements.title: Moisture content
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Moisture content at compaction within the specified range of optimum from the moisture-density curve. Range: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: relative-compaction
elements.title: Relative compaction (lowest test)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Every field density test is at or above the specified percentage of maximum dry density; failing areas are reworked and retested. Specified percentage: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.reference: ASTM D6938 (nuclear) or D1556 (sand cone); ASTM D698 / D1557

elements.name: test-frequency
elements.title: Test frequency met
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Number of density tests per lift and per area meets the specified frequency. Frequency: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: grade-check
elements.title: Finished grade (largest deviation)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Finished subgrade or fill surface within the specified tolerance of design elevation. Tolerance: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: release-to-cover
elements.title: Release before covering or building on fill
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Compaction results, grade survey and corrections are complete and accepted for this area before base, slab or structure is placed on it.

templates.name: Underground conduit / duct bank before backfill
templates.description: Trench and bedding, conduit arrangement, joints, bends, mandrel pull, depth of cover, as-built and release for encasement or backfill. NEC references.

body.title: Underground conduit / duct bank before backfill

elements.name: materials
elements.title: Conduit and fittings submittal accepted
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Conduit type, schedule, fittings, spacers and cement are as accepted and listed for the installation (direct burial or concrete-encased).

elements.name: trench
elements.title: Trench and bedding
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Trench is at the line and depth shown, sides are stable and protected as required, bottom is free of rocks and standing water, and bedding is placed and compacted as detailed.
elements.reference: Electrical site plan; OSHA 29 CFR 1926 Subpart P

elements.name: arrangement
elements.title: Conduit count, size and arrangement
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Number, size and position of conduits in each run match the duct-bank section on the drawings, including spares.

elements.name: spacer-interval
elements.title: Spacer interval (largest)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Spacers installed at no more than the specified interval and the conduits held at the detailed separation. Interval: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: joints
elements.title: Joints and couplings
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Every joint fully seated and made with the listed method (solvent cement or threaded); couplings staggered where detailed; end bells or bushings at terminations.

elements.name: bends
elements.title: Total bends between pull points (largest run)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: No run has more than 360° of bends between pull points.

elements.name: proof-pull
elements.title: Mandrel / proof pull
elements.acceptanceCriteria: A mandrel or test plug sized for the conduit passes through every conduit; pull string or tape left in each. Mandrel size: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: grounding-conductor
elements.title: Grounding conductor (if specified)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Ground conductor installed along the duct bank where detailed, with connections made as specified. Mark N/A when none is shown.

elements.name: cover-depth
elements.title: Depth of cover (smallest measured)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Cover from finished grade to the top of the conduit or encasement is at least the depth on the drawings and not less than the NEC Table 300.5 minimum for the wiring method and location. Depth: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: encasement-cover
elements.title: Concrete encasement cover (if encased)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Forms or spacers give the detailed concrete cover around the outermost conduits; reinforcement installed where detailed. Cover: Project-specific value required — verify before issue. Mark N/A for direct burial.

elements.name: as-built
elements.title: As-built location recorded
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Run alignment, depth and stub-up locations are surveyed or measured from fixed points and recorded before they are covered.

elements.name: release-to-backfill
elements.title: Release for encasement / backfill
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Every earlier line is passed or marked N/A and the run is photographed end to end before encasement or backfill starts. Warning tape is ready to place at the depth shown.
elements.recordRequired: Signed release; photos of the full run

templates.name: Piping pressure test
templates.description: Test package, joints and examinations, gauges and relief, pressure hold, leak examination, drain and test record. Code-neutral: the governing code and numbers are set per project.

elements.name: test-package
elements.title: Test package accepted
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Test package names the system and limits (marked-up drawings or isometrics), governing code, test medium, design pressure, test pressure and hold time, and the isolation and venting points. Test pressure and hold time: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.reference: Governing piping code (e.g. ASME B31.1, B31.3, B31.9, or the plumbing / water code in force)

elements.name: welds-complete
elements.title: Joints complete and examinations accepted
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Every joint in the test limits is complete; required examinations (visual, radiographic or other NDE) are accepted; supports are installed or temporary supports added for a water-filled test.
elements.reference: Governing piping code; weld / joint log

elements.name: joints-exposed
elements.title: Joints exposed for examination
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Joints are left uninsulated, unpainted and visible for the leak examination unless the governing code permits otherwise.

elements.name: gauges
elements.title: Gauges and relief device
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Test gauges have current calibration and a range suited to the test pressure; a relief device set to protect the system from over-pressure is installed; equipment, instruments and expansion joints that cannot take the test pressure are isolated or removed. Gauge range and relief setting: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.recordRequired: Gauge serial numbers and calibration dates

elements.name: test-pressure
elements.title: Test pressure held
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Pressure held at not less than the test pressure in the accepted test package for the full hold time. Test pressure: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.reference: Governing piping code; accepted test package
elements.recordRequired: Start and end pressure readings with times

elements.name: hold-time
elements.title: Hold time
elements.acceptanceCriteria: At least the hold time in the accepted test package (and not less than the governing code's minimum). Hold time: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: pressure-drop
elements.title: Pressure drop not explained by temperature
elements.acceptanceCriteria: No pressure drop beyond what the recorded temperature change explains; any allowed loss is as stated in the test package. Allowed loss: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: leak-check
elements.title: Leak examination
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Every joint examined at the examination pressure; no leaks or weeping found. Leaks are repaired and the test is repeated.
elements.recordRequired: Leaks found and repairs made, if any

elements.name: drain-restore
elements.title: Drain, vent and restore
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Test medium drained and disposed of as permitted; temporary blinds, plugs and gauges removed; isolated items reinstated with new gaskets where required; system left vented or as instructed.

elements.name: test-record
elements.title: Test record signed
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Test report completed with system, limits, medium, pressures, times, gauge serial numbers and signatures, and filed with the turnover records.
